companyDescription: Post-quantum cryptography · QCIM quantum-secure compute-in-memory chip · QSSN quantum-safe stablecoin infrastructure · Direct beneficiary of June 22 White House quantum-security executive orders
priceNote: 52-week range $2.09-$16.00; all-time high $22.00 CAD (Oct 2025). Down ~76% from ATH — small-cap post-quantum cryptography pure play riding the same policy wave as the hardware quantum names.
summary: BTQ builds post-quantum cryptography infrastructure — QCIM (a quantum-secure compute-in-memory chip), QSSN (quantum-safe stablecoin infrastructure for banks/payment providers), and Bitcoin Quantum. The June 22, 2026 White House executive orders on quantum leadership and cryptographic security directly target BTQ's core business: moving federal systems to NIST-approved post-quantum cryptography, with CNSA 2.0 compliance deadlines running 2027-2035. The stock is down ~76% from its October 2025 all-time high of $22 CAD, and next earnings/corporate update (Aug 13) is the nearest hard catalyst for QCIM commercialization progress.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings / Shareholder Update
catalysts.description: Next scheduled corporate update. Watch for QCIM productization progress, QPerfect integration (acquisition finalized Jul 1, 2026), and QSSN pilot-to-commercial conversion signals.

catalysts.name: White House Quantum Security Executive Orders
catalysts.description: June 22, 2026: two executive orders — "Ushering in the Next Frontier of Quantum Innovation" and "Securing the Nation Against Advanced Cryptographic Attacks" — direct federal agencies to migrate high-value systems to NIST-approved post-quantum cryptography. CNSA 2.0 sets quantum-resistant requirements for new acquisitions starting 2027.

catalysts.name: QPerfect Acquisition + US Government Engagement
catalysts.description: Completed final approval for full acquisition of QPerfect (Jul 1, 2026), advancing digital-twin/emulation/control capabilities. BTQ also appointed a US Strategic Advisor to deepen engagement with government stakeholders and national security organizations.

risks: No single clean binary event — unlike an FDA date, BTQ's catalysts (policy tailwind, product commercialization) are diffuse and could take longer than the market currently expects to convert into revenue
Pre-commercial-scale — QCIM is still moving "toward productization" per the company's own language; no confirmed large customer contract yet
Competitive post-quantum cryptography landscape is crowded — many players (including large incumbents) are building NIST-compliant solutions
Down ~76% from its October 2025 ATH — shows this name can also give back gains just as fast when policy-news enthusiasm fades
Micro-cap liquidity risk — thin trading can amplify both up and down moves beyond what the underlying news justifies

estimateDates.note: QCIM productization + QPerfect integration + QSSN pilot progress

macroRisk.rateOutlook: BTQ's federal/government-adjacent business is driven by national-security policy mandates (CNSA 2.0 compliance timelines), not FOMC rate decisions.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Early-stage R&D cost base is mostly personnel — modest wage-inflation sensitivity, not a primary driver.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: LOW-MEDIUM. The policy tailwind is structural, but as a pre-revenue-scale micro-cap, BTQ's trading multiple is more exposed to the current hawkish-Fed backdrop (hike priced by October) than the underlying government-security narrative alone would suggest.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk LOW for the policy catalyst itself, but this is a thin, pre-revenue-scale micro-cap — general risk-off sentiment from a hawkish Fed can move it as much as company news.

entryStrategy.verdict: ค่าขนม SPECULATIVE — 2-3% max. Base (steady commercialization) → $9.06 (+70%), Bull (named contract win) → $13.86 (+160%), Moon (major gov security deal, ATH retest) → $21.32 (+300%). No hard catalyst date — size small and be patient.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Quantum-policy-adjacent small-caps have run hard on White House/Commerce Dept announcements even without a company-specific award — the May 2026 quantum equity-stake news moved the entire sector, hardware and cryptography names alike.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: days-weeks ก่อน policy headline (unpredictable timing)

postWin.note: May 21, 2026 quantum equity-stake announcement: D-Wave +33%, Rigetti +30%, Infleqtion +31% in a single day. BTQ is a different sub-sector (post-quantum cryptography vs. quantum hardware) but sits in the same policy-driven news cycle — a named federal cryptography contract would likely trigger a similar-scale reaction given BTQ's smaller float.

postLose.note: BTQ itself has already fallen ~76% from its October 2025 all-time high of $22 CAD as early enthusiasm cooled without a hard commercial contract landing — direct evidence of how far this specific name can fall on narrative fade alone.

spotSizing.reason: 2% — no single dated binary catalyst (unlike the FDA plays on this list), thin micro-cap liquidity, and a company still describing its lead product as "moving toward productization" rather than commercially scaled.

risks: ไม่มี binary event เดี่ยวๆ ที่ชัดเจน — ต่างจากวัน FDA catalyst ของ BTQ (policy tailwind, product commercialization) เป็นเรื่องกระจาย อาจใช้เวลานานกว่าที่ตลาดคาดกว่าจะแปลงเป็น revenue
ยังไม่ถึงระดับ commercial scale — QCIM ยังอยู่ระหว่าง "มุ่งสู่ productization" ตามคำพูดของบริษัทเอง ยังไม่มี contract ลูกค้าใหญ่ที่ยืนยันชัดเจน
ตลาด post-quantum cryptography แข่งขันสูง — ผู้เล่นหลายรายรวมถึงบริษัทใหญ่กำลังสร้าง solution ที่ compliant กับ NIST เหมือนกัน
ร่วงมาแล้ว ~76% จาก ATH เดือน ต.ค. 2025 — แสดงว่าหุ้นตัวนี้คืนกำไรได้เร็วพอกันเมื่อความตื่นเต้นจากข่าว policy จางลง
ความเสี่ยงสภาพคล่อง micro-cap — ปริมาณซื้อขายบางทำให้ราคาแกว่งแรงเกินกว่าข่าวจริงทั้งขาขึ้นและขาลง
